stageMeta.title: Persistent Agent: memory survives process exit
headerComment: # Stage 02 — Persistent Agent: memory survives process exit
# Same Agent spine as Stage 01, plus two persistence plugins:
#   session-persistence-jsonl  writes the event log to ./sessions/<id>.jsonl
#   session-checkpoint-policy checkpoints before each model request
# The agent-loop itself is unchanged. Memory is NOT inside the loop —
# it's a separate capability seam (session persistence) that the loop
# happens to write to. Swap JSONL for SQLite and the loop never notices.
# This is the foundation for all later stages: L3–L6 inherit these two
# plugins so the agent can always resume across process restarts.
stageMeta.driverQuestion: 用一句话说明插件化架构的好处
